title: FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification
abstract: arXiv:2606.30376v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aligning generative flow models on continuous spaces via online reinforcement learning is constrained by intractable trajectory likelihoods. Existing density-approximated policy gradient methods rely on stochastic SDE samplers to construct tractable transition kernels, which introduce training-inference inconsistencies and necessitates Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG).   While implicit frameworks such as DiffusionNFT directly optimize forward-process velocity fields, its heuristic fixed-magnitude corrections prevent optimization strength from relative intra-group quality.   We propose \textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification} (\textbf{FlowAWR}), a paradigm that recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field. translated_title: FlowAWR：基于优势加权矫正的在线自适应流强化学习
translated_abstract: 通过在线强化学习在连续空间上对齐生成流模型受到难以处理的轨迹似然的限制。现有的密度近似策略梯度方法依赖随机SDE采样器来构建可处理的转移核，这引入了训练与推理之间的不一致性，并且需要依赖无分类器引导（CFG）。而以DiffusionNFT为代表的隐式框架虽然直接优化前向过程的速度场，但其启发式的固定幅度校正无法使优化强度与组内相对质量相关联。我们提出了流优势加权矫正（FlowAWR），这一范式将连续生成策略优化重新表述为朝向理论最优速度场的监督回归。从KL约束奖励最大化的最优策略出发，FlowAWR推导出一种具有幅度感知、自适应……（原文摘要在此处截断）特性的最优速度场。
tldr: FlowAWR提出将连续生成流模型的策略优化重构为朝向理论最优速度场的监督回归范式，通过优势加权矫正实现幅度感知的自适应优化，解决了现有方法中训练-推理不一致及固定幅度校正的局限。
en_tdlr: FlowAWR recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field, deriving a magnitude-aware, adaptive advantage-weighted rectification scheme that overcomes train-inference inconsistencies and fixed-magnitude correction limitations of prior methods.
